title: VonHHBraden source-window accepted-progress receipt and restart contract

ownership.commit_authority: Existing F-KT accepted receipt; WU04C may advance only after a ready receipt.
ownership.restart_owner: Typed WU04C continuation record, separate from hydraulic physical state.

rules: The first accepted receipt starts at source_t0; each later receipt starts exactly at accepted_through_time.
A receipt must end within the source window and must advance time.
Accepted interception is monotonic, finite, nonnegative and cannot exceed frozen aintc except for representation-level tolerance.
Rejected or stale trials have no ready receipt and cannot advance WU04C progress.
Restart restores only a validated accepted boundary; it does not reconstruct progress from hydraulic state or replay a rejected trial.
nonclaims: No production dynamic-top composition is admitted by this contract alone.
No WU03 SWINTER=0 interface is widened.
No canopy-loss mass ledger is added; hydraulic top-boundary mass ownership remains unchanged.
